name: Rikers Island, long dormitory sheds of the penitentiary yard (six parallel sheds, footprint 2109478)
note: The six long parallel sheds stand on this outline in the City's 1951 aerial mosaic and are not on the 1924 one; the built file had 1984.8 (neighbours). Rikers' jail opened 1932 (DOC history page jailist1.html); the sheds were built between the two photographs: 1940 is the middle of 1932-1951, ESTIMATED. Use of the buildings not identified.

name: Rikers Island, hollow-square building at the northern end (footprint 2116653)
note: A hollow-square building with a courtyard stands on this outline in the City's 1951 aerial mosaic; the row of site_map:rikers_island_jails:2116653 (1961, 'absent on the 1956 sheet') is contradicted by the photograph. Built after the jail opened in 1932 and before 1951; 1936 ESTIMATED (the DOC history page dates the original Rikers Island Hospital to 1932 and the Penitentiary to 1933, which this may be; not established).

name: Hunts Point Produce Market, building (footprint 2109490)
note: One of the big sheds of the Produce Market, which opened in 1967 ('the openings of the New York City Produce market in 1967 and Hunts Point Meat Market in 1974': Wikipedia, Hunts Point); the built file dated it from its neighbours' years (2003-08 for the meat sheds, 1971-76 for the produce ones), which leaves the market's ground empty in 1980. Opening year used for the whole market: ESTIMATED (an extension of a later year is possible; the 1951 photograph shows the ground as dump and marsh).
